input.name: linear-ring
input.source:
---- MODULE LinearRing ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE x
Init == x=0
Next == x'=IF x<N-1 THEN x+1 ELSE 0
Safe == (x \in 0..(N-1)) /\ (x<N-1)
====
input.config:
CONSTANT N=17
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
